CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.community_member_draft_projection(d zoi.community_member_drafts)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'version',d.version,'state',d.state,'payload',d.payload,'post_id',d.post_id,'updated_at',d.updated_at,'media_assets',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'type',CASE WHEN a.mime_type='video/mp4'THEN'video'ELSE'image'END,'mime_type',a.mime_type,'width',a.metadata->'width','height',a.metadata->'height','duration_seconds',a.metadata->'duration_seconds'))FROM zoi.community_media_assets a WHERE a.profile_id=d.profile_id AND d.payload->'media' @> to_jsonb(ARRAY[a.id::text])),'[]'))$function$
